frames.visible_job: Draw a shallow tilted sleeve with its front face and short thickness edges.
frames.instruction: Draw a short horizontal rectangle tilted slightly upward to the right. Echo its lower and left edges to give the cardboard sleeve a little thickness; leave its right end clear for the tray.

frames.visible_job: Add one shallow open tray emerging halfway from the sleeve's right end.
frames.instruction: From the sleeve's open right edge, extend a shallow tray about half a box length. Draw the raised rim first, then join its inner floor; keep the rim visible so the matches have a place to rest.

frames.visible_job: Place exactly three separate matchsticks with heads inside the fixed tray.
frames.instruction: Lay three slim, nearly parallel sticks across the tray floor, each slanting slightly toward the upper right. Give each one a small rounded head; count all three before adding texture.

frames.visible_job: Add a blank inset label, a narrow striking strip, and a broken shadow.
frames.instruction: Inset a blank label rectangle on the broad sleeve face. Along the narrow lower side, add a rough striking strip. With the side of the pencil, place a broken shadow just below the box.

final_step.visible_job: Shade established cardboard, wood, match heads, and shadow without introducing new contours.
final_step.instruction: Layer muted ochre on the sleeve and sticks, dusty red on the three existing heads, and graphite on the striking strip and shadow. Strengthen only the contours already in place.
adds: color and shading on established forms
